ValidationRule.description: Date Loyalty Specialist Assigned cannot be in the Past or the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((RecordType_Name__c = "Retention RM") || (RecordType_Name__c = "Retention SH")) && NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Loyalty_Specialist_Assigned__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Loyalty_Specialist_Assigned__c)) && Date_Loyalty_Specialist_Assigned__c != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Loyalty_Specialist_Assigned__c)) || Date_Loyalty_Specialist_Assigned__c != PRIORVALUE(Date_Loyalty_Specialist_Assigned__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Loyalty Specialist Assigned cannot be in the Past or the Future.
